Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators without a reliable way to accept payments. This guide will show you how to utilize Supabase as your order database, enabling you to establish a robust digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on conventional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH is designed specifically to circumvent the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms. In regions where payment systems collapse or become inaccessible, using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions empowers you to maintain complete control over your digital commerce. This architecture is built for resilience, ensuring that your online store operates smoothly even in the face of financial instability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the required tools: a GitHub account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for processing payments, and a Google account for managing your order database with Google Sheets or Supabase. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as it outlines the deployment process for Stack 01, which takes approximately 4-6 hours. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, as this streamlines the setup once the infrastructure is in place.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, first deploy your order management system using Supabase or Google Sheets. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring you select a network like BSC or Solana for low fees. After configuring your payment gateway, test the entire transaction process in a controlled environment to confirm that payments are verified and product deliveries are seamless. This setup allows you to manage orders efficiently and provides transparency in payment processing.
Own your infrastructure fully; there's no dependency on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is configured, you’re ready to go live. Announce your store to your audience and encourage initial transactions. Monitor the payment process closely for any issues, ensuring that orders are processed through NOWPayments without a hitch. This is a critical step; a smooth launch will help build trust with your customers. Utilize the 30-day support provided with your Stack deployment to address any challenges during this period.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store, focus on scaling your operations. Introduce more products into your catalog, leveraging the capacity of your Supabase database to manage increased order volumes. Consider implementing marketing strategies to drive traffic to your site, such as social media campaigns and collaborations with other creators. The Edge Commerce Stack, which includes additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, can enhance your store's reliability and performance, ensuring it remains robust as you scale.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy your store in under 48 hours with proven architectures.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account to host your store. 2. Sign up for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. 3. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets as your order management system. 4. Prepare your digital products for upload. 5. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for deployment. 6. Set up your payment gateway with NOWPayments. 7. Test the entire transaction process before going live. 8. Announce your store and monitor initial transactions closely.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use GitHub Pages for hosting, Supabase as your order database, and NOWPayments for processing transactions. This combination allows you to operate independently of conventional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. In contrast, Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers with Supabase, deployed in 48 hours and end-to-end tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each option provides a reliable hosting solution that supports the infrastructure needed for crypto payments and product delivery.
What are the benefits of using Supabase for my order database?

Supabase offers a powerful and open-source alternative to traditional databases, providing real-time capabilities and seamless integration with your payment gateway, ensuring efficient order management for your digital store.
How can I ensure my transactions are secure?

To ensure your transactions are secure, utilize NOWPayments for crypto processing, which operates on established blockchain networks. Additionally, implement best practices like SSL certificates for your store to protect sensitive data.
